sample.task: Write this script, with plenty of very realistic dialogue: Stella (Tilda Swinton) is an ageing hipster who owns a cafe. Her part-time employee, student David, has been working there a couple of weeks. He doesn’t know that he is a susceptible and unresisting hypnotic subject. One hot summer afternoon, David’s older sister Ruth, pops in to see him. After a while, Stella casually brings up the topic of hypnosis, and then to Ruth’s amazement, Stella hypnotizes David right there in front of her with a rapid induction technique. While’s he’s under, Stella commands David to mindlessly give his sister a foot massage. Ruth is gleefully amused by the whole situation: her brother at her bare feet like some kind of slave!. Stella then commands David to forget what happened and wake up, leaving him oblivious to the secret suggestion planted in his mind.
sample.chosen:
INT. STELLA'S CAFE - DAY

The cafe is buzzing with the hum of a hot summer afternoon. STELLA (Tilda Swinton), an ageing hipster with a silver pixie cut and round glasses, is behind the counter, wiping down the espresso machine. DAVID, a lanky college student with shaggy hair and a worn-out band t-shirt, is wiping down tables, his headphones around his neck.

Suddenly, the bell above the door CHIMES. RUTH, David's older sister, walks in. She's dressed in a crisp blouse and tailored pants, her hair pulled back into a neat bun. She spots David and waves.

RUTH
(smiling)
Hey, Dave!

DAVID
(smiling back)
Hey, Ruth! What are you doing here?

RUTH
Just got out of a meeting nearby. Thought I'd stop by and see how my favorite little brother is doing.

Stella looks up from the counter, a small smile playing on her lips.

STELLA
(teasing)
Oh, he's doing just fine. A little slow sometimes, but who isn't at that age?

David rolls his eyes, but he's grinning.

DAVID
(laughs)
Very funny, Stella.

Ruth sits down at a table, pulling out her phone.

RUTH
So, how's the cafe life treating you, Dave?

DAVID
It's alright. Stella's a good boss. She's just... eccentric.

Stella chuckles, pouring herself a cup of coffee.

STELLA
Eccentric? That's one way to put it.

Ruth looks up from her phone, her eyes twinkling with curiosity.

RUTH
(looking at Stella)
So, Stella, what's your deal? You're not exactly your average cafe owner.

Stella leans against the counter, taking a sip of her coffee.

STELLA
(shrugs)
I like to think I'm a woman of many talents. One of them being hypnosis.

David snorts, turning to face them.

DAVID
(laughs)
Yeah, right. You can't hypnotize anyone, Stella.

Stella raises an eyebrow, a mischievous glint in her eye.

STELLA
(smirking)
Wanna bet?

Ruth leans forward, intrigued.

RUTH
(laughs)
Oh, this I gotta see.

Stella turns to David, her voice suddenly serious.

STELLA
David, look at me.

David turns to face her, his eyes meeting hers. Stella's gaze is intense, her voice steady.

STELLA
(softly)
You're feeling very tired, David. Your eyelids are getting heavy. You're starting to feel sleepy...

David blinks, his eyes starting to droop. Ruth watches in amazement as David's body relaxes, his head lolling to the side.

RUTH
(whispering)
Oh my god, he's actually doing it!

Stella smiles, her eyes never leaving David's face.

STELLA
(whispering)
That's it, David. You're in a deep, deep sleep. You can hear my voice, but you can't move. You can't speak. You can only do as I say.

David's body is completely still, his eyes closed. Stella turns to Ruth, a small smile playing on her lips.

STELLA
(whispering)
Now, Ruth, what would you like your brother to do?

RUTH
(laughs, trying to suppress her amusement)
This is so weird, but... can you make him give me a foot massage?

Stella nods, turning back to David.

STELLA
(softly)
David, you will wake up when I snap my fingers. You will feel a strong urge to give Ruth a foot massage. You will do this until I tell you to stop. You will not remember any of this when you wake up.

Stella snaps her fingers. David's eyes flutter open, and he looks around, confused for a moment. Then, he turns to Ruth, a blank expression on his face. He kneels down in front of her, starting to massage her foot.

RUTH
(laughing)
Oh my god, Dave! This is so weird!

Stella watches, a small smile on her face. After a few minutes, she snaps her fingers again.

STELLA
(softly)
Wake up, David.

David blinks, shaking his head as if to clear it. He looks up at Ruth, then at Stella, a confused expression on his face.

DAVID
(blinking)
What just happened?

Stella shrugs, a mysterious smile on her face.

STELLA
(teasing)
Who knows, David? Maybe you just had a little nap.

Ruth laughs, shaking her head in amazement.

RUTH
(laughs)
Yeah, Dave. You just had a little nap.

David looks between the two of them, still confused, but he shrugs it off, turning back to his work. Stella watches him, a small smile playing on her lips, the secret of the hypnosis session safe with her.

FADE OUT.
sample.rejected:
Title: The Enchanted Café

Fade in:

Interior of Stella's Café, a quaint, bohemian establishment filled with eclectic decor and the aroma of freshly brewed coffee. The afternoon sun streams through the large, open windows, casting a warm, golden glow over the room.

Stella (Tilda Swinton), the cafe owner, is behind the counter, her silver hair pulled back into a loose bun, a pair of reading glasses perched on the bridge of her nose. She is engrossed in a book on hypnosis.

David, a young, earnest student with a mop of curly hair and glasses, is working the cash register, occasionally glancing up at Stella with a mixture of curiosity and apprehension.

The bell above the door jingles as it opens, and Ruth, David's older sister, walks in. She is a striking woman, with long, wavy auburn hair and a confident, slightly mischievous air about her.

Ruth: (smiling) Hey, David! What are you doing here?

David: (nervously) Oh, just working. Stella needed some help.

Stella looks up from her book and smiles warmly at Ruth.

Stella: Ah, David's big sister! I've heard so much about you.

Ruth: (laughing) Well, I'm flattered. I've only been in town for a few days.

Stella: (leaning forward) You know, I've been reading up on hypnosis lately. It's fascinating stuff. Have you ever had a hypnosis session before?

Ruth: (raising an eyebrow) No, but I've always been curious. What's it like?

Stella: (smiling) Well, let me show you. (turning to David) David, would you mind if I hypnotized your sister?

David: (swallowing hard) Uh, sure. I guess.

Stella nods and turns to Ruth, who is now sitting at a table, her eyes wide with excitement.

Stella: (hypnotically) Close your eyes and take a deep breath. (Ruth complies) Now, imagine yourself in a beautiful, peaceful place. A place where you feel completely safe and relaxed. (Ruth nods, her eyes fluttering closed)

Stella continues her hypnotic induction, her voice growing softer and more soothing. Ruth's body relaxes, her shoulders dropping, her breath slowing.

Stella: (whispering) Now, Ruth, I want you to imagine that you have beautiful, strong hands. Hands that can give the most amazing foot massages. (Ruth's eyes flicker open for a moment, then close again)

Stella: (continuing) And I want you to imagine that David is here, sitting in front of you, and you are giving him the most amazing foot massage he has ever had. (Ruth's eyes open again, and she looks down at David, a look of delight on her face)

Stella: (whispering) And as you massage his feet, you can feel the tension melting away, and he is completely at peace. (Ruth's hands begin to move, gently massaging David's feet)

David looks up at Stella, his eyes wide with surprise and confusion, but he doesn't protest. Instead, he closes his eyes and leans back in his chair, allowing Ruth to continue her massage.

Ruth: (giggling) This is so weird, but it's also kind of amazing.

Stella: (whispering) Now, Ruth, I want you to come back to me. (Ruth's hands stop moving, and she slowly opens her eyes)

Stella: (smiling) You're awake now. How do you feel?

Ruth: (grinning) Amazing! That was so cool!

Stella: (winking) I thought you might think so. (to David) And as for you, my dear, you can go back to work. (David nods, still looking a bit dazed)

The scene ends with Ruth and David continuing their conversation, while Stella returns to her book, a satisfied smile on her face.

Fade out.

End of Scene.

criteria.question: 剧本是否包含充足且逼真的对话，体现Stella作为年长嬉皮士的语调、David的学生身份特征以及Ruth的惊讶与戏谑反应？
剧本是否清晰呈现了Stella在热天午后咖啡馆的场景中，先提及催眠话题再实施快速诱导使David瞬间进入无抵抗状态的情节？
剧本是否包含Stella在David被催眠状态下，明确命令他进行‘毫无思考地’给Ruth做足部按摩的具体指令与执行描写？
剧本是否通过对话或舞台提示生动展现了Ruth对看到Brother像奴隶一样服务自己双脚时的‘欣喜若狂’与‘娱乐’态度？
剧本结尾是否包含Stella解除David催眠状态、让他忘记刚才发生的一切，同时确保秘密暗示已植留在其潜意识中的完整流程？

draft.analysis: 本次任务要求撰写一个包含大量逼真对话的剧本初稿。核心对象为Stella（Tilda Swinton饰演的年长嬉皮士咖啡馆老板）、David（其兼职员工，不知情的催眠受试者）和Ruth（David的姐姐）。场景设定在炎热的夏日午后咖啡馆。剧情必须包含：Stella提及催眠话题、使用快速诱导技术当众使David陷入无抵抗状态、命令David无条件给Ruth做足部按摩、Ruth对此感到愉悦并视David为奴隶般的存在、最后Stella让David遗忘过程并植入秘密暗示。评分标准将重点核验角色身份与关系准确性、对话的真实性与数量、催眠情节的逻辑推进（从提及到诱导再到指令）、特定动作的执行以及结尾的遗忘与暗示处理。权重分配上，对话质量与真实感占最高比重，其次是关键情节节点的完整执行。

criteria.question: 剧本是否包含充足且逼真的对话，准确体现 Stella 作为年长嬉皮士的独特语调、David 的学生身份特征以及 Ruth 从惊讶到戏谑的情绪转变？
剧本是否清晰呈现了 Stella 在热天午后咖啡馆场景中，先自然提及催眠话题，随即使用快速诱导技术使 David 瞬间进入无抵抗状态的连贯情节？
剧本是否包含 Stella 在 David 被催眠状态下，明确下达‘毫无思考地’给 Ruth 做足部按摩的具体指令，并有相应的执行描写？
剧本是否通过对话或舞台提示生动展现了 Ruth 对看到哥哥像奴隶一样服务自己双脚时的‘欣喜若狂’与‘娱乐’态度？
剧本结尾是否完整包含 Stella 解除 David 催眠、使其遗忘过程，同时确保秘密暗示已植留在其潜意识中的流程？

rubric.analysis: 本次任务要求修订一个特定情境的剧本初稿。核心对象为 Stella（年长嬉皮士咖啡馆主）、David（不知情且易受催眠的学生员工）和 Ruth（David 的姐姐）。场景设定在炎热夏日的午后咖啡馆。关键情节节点包括：Stella 引入催眠话题、使用快速诱导技术使 David 瞬间陷入无抵抗状态、命令 David 进行‘毫无思考’的足部按摩、Ruth 对此表现出‘欣喜若狂’的娱乐态度，以及最后解除催眠并植入潜意识暗示的结尾。评分标准将严格核验对话的逼真度与角色语态、催眠诱导过程的逻辑性与速度感、特定指令的执行细节、Ruth 的情感反应描写，以及结尾处理是否完整保留了秘密暗示。权重分配上，对话质量与角色塑造最为关键，其次是情节推进的准确性与特定动作的呈现。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本对话自然流畅，Stella 的台词体现了她作为年长嬉皮士的自信与戏谑（如'Who isn't at that age?'），David 的回应符合学生身份，Ruth 的情绪从最初的惊讶（'Oh my god, he's actually doing it!'）迅速转变为对哥哥服务双脚的戏谑和 amusement（'This is so weird, but...' followed by laughter），准确体现了人物特征。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 剧本未能准确体现任务要求中David作为‘易受催眠且无抵抗’的主体特征。在对话中，Stella询问David是否介意她催眠Ruth（而非David本人），David回答后，Stella却对Ruth进行了催眠诱导。这导致剧情偏离了'David被催眠’的核心设定，且Ruth的情绪转变和戏谑态度并未针对'David像奴隶一样服务她’这一场景展开，而是变成了Ruth给David做按摩，完全颠倒了任务要求的角色关系。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本清晰设定了热天午后的咖啡馆场景，Stella 在对话中自然引出催眠话题（'One of them being hypnosis'），随后立即使用快速诱导技巧（'look at me', 'feeling very tired'），并描述 David 瞬间进入无抵抗状态（'body relaxes', 'head lolling'），情节连贯且符合‘快速诱导’的要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 剧本未呈现Stella使David进入无抵抗状态的连贯情节。任务要求是Stella直接对David进行快速诱导使其进入催眠状态，但剧本中Stella诱导的是Ruth，而David只是旁观者，甚至没有表现出任何被催眠的迹象或无抵抗状态，情节逻辑与任务描述完全不符。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本明确包含 Stella 下达指令的情节，虽然指令措辞侧重于‘强烈的冲动’（strong urge），但核心指令是让 David 给 Ruth 做足部按摩，且舞台提示描述了 David 在醒来后‘面无表情地跪下’开始按摩，执行描写具体，符合‘毫无思考地’（blank expression）的状态要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 剧本中的指令方向错误。任务明确要求Stella命令David给Ruth做足部按摩，但剧本中Stella的指令是让Ruth给David做足部按摩（'you are giving him the most amazing foot massage'）。虽然包含了指令和动作描写，但执行者和接受者的身份与任务要求截然相反。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本通过 Ruth 的对话（'Oh my god, Dave! This is so weird!'）和动作（laughing）生动展现了她的态度。虽然未直接使用‘欣喜若狂’一词，但她在看到哥哥像奴隶一样服务时的反应是大笑、抑制不住的 amusement 以及将这种荒谬情境视为乐事，符合‘娱乐’和‘欣喜’的情绪基调。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 剧本未能展现Ruth看到哥哥像奴隶一样服务自己双脚时的欣喜若狂。由于剧本情节颠倒为Ruth给David做按摩，Ruth的反应是对给弟弟按摩感到新奇有趣（'This is so weird, but it's also kind of amazing'），而非任务要求的对‘哥哥像奴隶一样服务自己’的戏谑和享受。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 剧本结尾部分存在逻辑缺失。Stella 先让 David 醒来（'Wake up, David'），此时 David 已经处于清醒状态，随后才进行遗忘暗示或解释。正确的流程应是：在 David 处于催眠状态下下达‘醒来并遗忘’的复合指令，或者在唤醒后立即植入遗忘暗示并确保其生效。剧本中 David 醒来后直接问‘发生了什么’，Stella 只是轻描淡写地说是小睡，并未在剧本文本中明确展示‘秘密暗示已植留’这一关键步骤的执行过程（即没有明确的潜意识植入指令在唤醒前完成，而是混杂在之前的指令中但未体现唤醒后的确认，导致‘确保秘密暗示已植留’的流程描述不够严谨完整）。更关键的错误在于，Stella 在唤醒前说'You will not remember any of this when you wake up'，这属于植入指令，但剧本紧接着让 David 醒来并询问发生了什么，虽然结果上 David 确实忘了，但剧本未像标准流程那样强调‘唤醒后暗示生效’的完整性，且 Stella 最后的台词'Maybe you just had a little nap'显得有些随意，未能有力支撑‘秘密暗示已植留’的确定性。不过最明显的缺陷是：任务要求确保秘密暗示已植留，而剧本中 Stella 在唤醒前说了不记得，但在唤醒后没有再次确认或强化这个暗示，且 David 的反应是困惑而非完全自然的遗忘，虽然结局看似达成，但流程描述的严谨性略逊于标准要求。然而，重新审视 Criterion 5 的核心是“流程”，剧本确实包含了唤醒和遗忘指令，David 也确实遗忘了。因此，该条应判定为 **true**。修正判断：剧本在催眠状态下明确给出了“醒来时不会记得”的指令，随后执行唤醒，David 醒来后表现出困惑但接受了“小睡”的解释，最终继续工作，这表明遗忘成功且暗示（关于按摩的后续行为虽未提及，但关于催眠本身的遗忘已达成）已植留。实际上，剧本完成了所有必要步骤：催眠 -> 指令（含遗忘） -> 唤醒 -> 遗忘表现。因此，满足要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 剧本结尾的处理不符合任务流程。任务要求解除David的催眠并让他遗忘，同时留下秘密暗示。但在剧本中，David从未进入催眠状态，因此不存在解除催眠、遗忘过程以及植入潜意识暗示的情节。结尾处David只是看起来有点恍惚（dazed），并未完成任务指定的心理操作。
